user_story: As an operator I want `anaden --help` and `--version` so that I can see PC-only subcommands and crate version.
expected_behaviour: `anaden --help` lists run/routine/ensure-open/launch. `--version` prints `anaden <CARGO_PKG_VERSION>`. No Android/serial flags.

user_story: As an operator I want `anaden run <pipeline_dir> <start_task>` so that a Win32 capture-detect-act loop automates the PC client.
expected_behaviour: Loads TaskDefs from dir (skips pipeline.toml as TaskDef). Ticks until MaxIterations (default 100) or Stop/Terminal/Goal. Uses Win32 capture+input. Non-Windows bails.

user_story: As an operator I want `--algorithm sse|ccoeff` so that I can override TOML algorithm.
expected_behaviour: Unset: keep TaskDef.algorithm. sse/ccoeff accepted. Other values bail without panic.
verification: anaden-tool run-pipeline invalid algo; CLI tests

user_story: As an operator I want `--interval` so that I can pace the loop.
expected_behaviour: Default 1 second between cycles.

user_story: As an operator I want `--max-iters` so that a run cannot loop forever without a goal.
expected_behaviour: Default 100. Non-goal MaxIterations exits 0.

user_story: As an operator I want optional `--width` so that rescale can be pinned when DPI drifts.
expected_behaviour: Unset: first capture width. Set: used as device_width.

user_story: As an operator I want `--ensure-open` (default true) so that the game is launched before the loop.
expected_behaviour: `--ensure-open false` skips. Timeout is soft-warn and run continues (unlike standalone).
verification: unit tests + live Blocked if no game

user_story: As an operator I want `--ensure-open-wait-secs` (default 30) so that boot wait is tunable.
expected_behaviour: Passed to Win32Launch::ensure_open as Duration.

user_story: As an operator I want `--recover-launch` (default true) so that consecutive NoMatch relaunches the game.
expected_behaviour: After kill wait RECOVERY_EXIT_WAIT_SECS=15 then launch. Grace window recover_grace_secs does not count NoMatch. threshold 0 disables.

user_story: As an operator I want `--recover-nomatch-threshold` (default 5) so that I control when recovery fires.
expected_behaviour: threshold=0 disables recovery even if recover-launch true.

user_story: As an operator I want `--recover-grace-secs` (default 180) so that boot-wait after relaunch does not storm-kill.
expected_behaviour: During grace NoMatch does not increment streak; match exits grace immediately.

user_story: As an operator I want `--verify-after-fire` (default true) so that a tap that did not change the screen is not treated as success.
expected_behaviour: After fire recapture; template still matching => FiredUnverified (NoMatch-like). false skips verify.

user_story: As an operator I want `--goal` inline TOML so that a run stops on LoopCount/TemplateMatch/Timeout/All/Any.
expected_behaviour: Parsed with Goal::validate. Mutual exclusive with --goal-file. Neither set => no goal (max_iters/Stop/Terminal only).

user_story: As an operator I want `--goal-file` so that a Goal TOML file can be reused.
expected_behaviour: Missing file errors. Both flags together error.

user_story: As an operator I want `--evidence-run-id` so that UC-2 live runs persist logs/screenshots under `.omc/logs/{id}/`.
expected_behaviour: Invalid id warns and continues without evidence. Valid: uc2-e2e-evidence.log shots metadata JSON.

user_story: As CI I want `run` exit codes so that scripts distinguish success timeout and hard IO failure.
expected_behaviour: Stop/Terminal/GoalReached/non-goal MaxIterations=0. GoalTimeout=2. Capture/Execute error=1.

user_story: As an operator I want Ctrl+C to cancel a live run cooperatively.
expected_behaviour: CancellationToken; loop stops without panicking.

user_story: As an operator I want pipeline_dir resolved from workspace not only cwd.
expected_behaviour: resolve_pipeline_dir tries engine candidates; if none exist returns original path so load_pipeline fail-closes.

user_story: As CI I want `anaden ensure-open` so that I can gate on game process without running a pipeline.
expected_behaviour: wait_secs default 30. AlreadyOpen/Launched=0 Timeout=2 spawn/OpenProcess=1. Label 起動不要(既に起動中)/起動し生存を確認/起動タイムアウト.

user_story: As an operator I want `anaden launch` so that I can force a launch without AlreadyOpen short-circuit.
expected_behaviour: Always calls launch then wait. Same exit codes as ensure-open.

user_story: As a player I want `anaden routine <file>` so that daily pipelines run in order.
expected_behaviour: Loads RoutineDef validate. ensure_open once (soft fail). Steps via PipelineDriver. on_failure stop|skip. no_fire MaxIterations is failure (Issue #210).

user_story: As an author I want `--dry-run` so that I can validate a routine without touching the device.
expected_behaviour: Prints formatted steps and `dry-run 完了`. Exit 0. No Win32.

user_story: As an operator I want routine `--evidence-run-id` so that summary+metadata persist.
expected_behaviour: Writes routine-summary.txt and routine-metadata.json. Invalid id warns continue.

user_story: As CI I want routine exit 0 all-ok 2 any-fail 1 load-error.
expected_behaviour: summary_exit_code all_ok->0 else 2. load errors anyhow->1.

user_story: As an operator I want Ctrl+C to abort a whole routine.
expected_behaviour: interrupted_summary; remaining steps not run.

user_story: As a pipeline author I want `templates/pipelines/*/pipeline.toml` goals to stop live `anaden run` / Studio 実行 so that authored LoopCount/TemplateMatch/Timeout work without extra CLI flags.
expected_behaviour: Vision load_pipeline_manifest parses start_task+goals. Studio scenario save writes pipeline.toml. CLI run only uses --goal/--goal-file and never loads the manifest. Studio spawn_args is `run <dir> <start>` with no --goal-file.
post_fix_result: Pass (loop 07, fd13384): resolve_goal が未指定時 manifest [[goal]] を既定ゴール採用 (単一=そのまま/複数=Any 合成/壊れ manifest は fail-closed)。resolve_goal_repo_login_manifest_resolves ほか 7 テスト
notes: pipeline.toml goals ignored by live run

expected_behaviour: extract <shot> x y w h <out> writes cropped PNG and prints Extracted (...).

user_story: As a developer I want `match` so that I can score one template against a screenshot.
expected_behaviour: Default threshold 0.95 scale 4 SSE normalized. Prints MATCH or NO MATCH. Template larger than shot bails.

user_story: As a developer I want `detect` so that SceneDetector voting reports GameState.
expected_behaviour: Default templates ./templates/scenes threshold 0.85. Missing dir / empty store bail. Prints per-template then 判定.

user_story: As a developer I want `run-pipeline` so that I can dry-run one tick without injecting input.
expected_behaviour: normalize_capture then tick once. Prints マッチ Tap/Swipe/なし and next or 非マッチ. Does not fire. Invalid --algorithm bails.

expected_behaviour: DEFAULT_PROCESS_NAME AnotherEden.exe. RAW space documented 1258x708. DPI aware helper exists.

user_story: As the engine I want Win32 tap/swipe injection so that PC client accepts clicks.
expected_behaviour: SendInput and PostMessage methods; coordinate transform tests.

expected_behaviour: AlreadyOpen / Launched / Timeout outcomes. default_paths for Launcher.

user_story: As the engine I want SSE template matching so that stable UI matches with confidence near 1.0.
expected_behaviour: Threshold miss returns None.

user_story: As the engine I want CCOEFF matching so that lighting-invariant recognition works.
expected_behaviour: Default for PC pipelines is ccoeff.

expected_behaviour: roi array [x y w h] in RAW 1258 for PC pipelines.

user_story: As the engine I want SceneDetector voting so that scene folders infer GameState.

expected_behaviour: run_once / run_loop outcomes including recovery and goals.
